journey.name: Signup — invite code to a working account
journey.description:
The path for a user who has no Pubky at all: obtain an account on a token-gated homeserver from inside Loopky, via a hand-issued invite code, and land on Home. Loopky mints the key and redeems the code itself — Pubky Ring is not involved and need not be installed (since 9372ff86; Ring is offered afterwards, as a backup).
Requires: Loopky debug build (which points at the **staging** environment) and Loopky signed out. A real staging signup token — mint one with the admin endpoint recorded in `local.properties`, into a file rather than the terminal:
curl -X GET "https://admin.homeserver.staging.pubky.app/generate_signup_token" \ -H "X-Admin-Password: <the one in local.properties>" > invite.txt
It returns a single `XXXX-XXXX-XXXX` code. **Tokens are single-use and never expire**, so a code spent by a previous run is gone — mint a fresh one per attempt rather than reusing.
Warning: getting onto these screens means signing out. A Ring-held account comes back with a QR scan; a Loopky-held one without a backup does not, so do not sign that one out.

actions.action: Launch Loopky. Verify the onboarding screen shows both "Sign in with Pubky Ring" (resource-id: onboarding_signin) and "Create a Pubky" (resource-id: onboarding_create_pubky)

Verify the method screen: "signup_title" reads "Prove you're not a robot." and "signup_method_sms", "signup_method_lightning" and "signup_method_invite" are all present, with no Pubky Ring install block above them

Verify "signup_method_lightning_price" reads "Pay ₿ 10 once" (possibly with a fiat figure beside it) — 10 sat is the STAGING price. If it reads 1000, the build is pointed at production and the staging token below will be rejected
THE FORMAT CHECK. Tap "signup_method_invite", tap "signup_invite_input", type "nope", tap "signup_invite_submit"
Verify "signup_error_title" reads "That code didn't work" and that the screen did NOT advance — a malformed code is rejected locally and must cost no network call
THE HAPPY PATH. Clear the field, type the freshly minted XXXX-XXXX-XXXX token (adb shell input text "$(cat invite.txt)" keeps it off the screen log), tap "signup_invite_submit"
Verify "signup_local_progress" appears — Loopky is minting the key and registering it, with no deeplink and no relay
Verify Loopky lands on Home, greeting the new pubky, with the "No decks yet" empty state and the backup reminder sheet ("backup_reminder_sheet") raised over it
Verify logcat shows "registerKey: registering <pubky prefix>…" and no secret key, mnemonic or token value anywhere in the Loopky tags
Verify Profile → Settings shows the new pubky and the staging homeserver (ufibwb…d9u1uy)

THE FAILURE BRANCH. Repeat with airplane mode on so registration fails. Verify the progress screen turns into an error with "signup_local_retry"; turn airplane mode off, tap it, and verify the account is created with the SAME pubky logcat named the first time (journey 22 has the full retry check)
